title: Blog Workflow
description: Blog writing workflow from idea until published and online. Roles: Content Strategist, Copywriter, Graphic Designer, Subject Expert, Content Editor

stages.title: Idea
stages.description: Basic stage. Every newly submitted article for Blog.

stages.title: Content Review
stages.description: The article is reviewed, checked for text, illustration, HTML.

stages.title: Unpublished
stages.description: A published article is unpublished and unfeatured

transitions.title: Write Article
transitions.description: The content strategist checks any idea which is submitted in category blog.

transitions.title: Graphic Design
transitions.description: The Graphic Designer can now add any illustrations.

transitions.title: Check Facts
transitions.description: The article is complete and must be checked by a subject expert.

transitions.title: Review Content
transitions.description: The complete article is reviewed.

transitions.title: Edit
transitions.description: The article must be reviewed.

transitions.title: Resume Idea
transitions.description: An article on hold can be resumed as idea.

transitions.title: Unpublish
transitions.description: A published article is unpublished.

transitions.title: Trash
transitions.description: Trash a published article.

transitions.title: Publish again
transitions.description: Re-activate an unpublished article.

title: Committee Workflow
description: Workflow for preparation of Committee papers.

transitions.title: Draft to Review
transitions.description: The Chair checks the papers are accurate.

transitions.title: Review to Draft
transitions.description: The Chair requires corrections.

transitions.title: Review to Publish
transitions.description: The Chair approves the papers for publication.

options.notification_text: A committee paper has been published and is now available to view.

transitions.title: Publish to Review
transitions.description: The Chair requires corrections.

transitions.title: Publish to Archive
transitions.description: Change item state from Published to Archived.

stages.title: Review
stages.description: Fix accuracy, grammar, readability and length.

stages.title: Archive
stages.description: The article is no longer current but needed for reference.

stages.title: Trash
stages.description: The article is not published and ready for deletion.

transitions.title: Draft to Review
transitions.description: The Editor checks that the article seems acceptable.

transitions.title: Review to Draft
transitions.description: There Reviewer decides something is wrong - back to author for corrections.

transitions.title: Review to Approve
transitions.description: The reviewer approves the article for publication.

options.notification_text: An article has been approved and is now pending publication.

transitions.title: Approve to Review
transitions.description: The Editor wants the Reviewer to deal with a problem.

options.notification_text: An article has been approved but still has problems.

transitions.title: Approve to Publish
transitions.description: The Editor approves the article for publication.

options.notification_text: An article has been approved and published.

transitions.title: Publish to Approve
transitions.description: There is a problem with a published article.

options.notification_text: An article has been approved and was published but has been unpublished. Please check the problem.

transitions.title: Publish to Archive
transitions.description: Change item state from Published to Archived.

transitions.title: All to Trash
transitions.description: Change item from any state to Trashed pending deletion.
